messages:
raj: Heads-up — proposal to shorten APAC ephemeral mTLS cert TTL from 24h -> 1h to reduce blast radius. Need quick feedback on RBAC token churn, KMS decrypt QPS, and audit log volume. Thinking rollout over one week with a canary.
maria: Good idea for security posture. Two quick asks: 1) will services re-request certs on rotation or rely on push? 2) Do we have metrics for KMS latency under a spike? :thinking_face:
raj: Services will attempt local re-request on TTL expiry; we also have a push-refresh webhook option for high-priority proxies. KMS QPS baseline for APAC last 7d is ~420 qps peak per region (observed). Can push more metrics if needed.
jon: From SRE, main worry is the sudden spike during deployment/canary if many pods restart simultaneously. We should stagger the rollout and add jitter to refresh backoff. Also increase KMS retry budget and monitor error budget.
kelsey: RBAC note — rotating certs more often means short-lived RBAC sessions might break if we bind sessions to cert thumbprints. We need to switch to session IDs that survive cert refresh or add a transient mapping layer in the auth proxy.
sam-oncall: +1 to jitter. Also request we add an incident playbook entry: if KMS throttling > 5% or TLS handshakes error > 1% sustained for 5m, trigger paged alert and revert to 24h TTL for affected region.
maria: Audit/observability: shortening TTL multiplies number of cert issue events. We should sample audit logs at creation for low-risk services and keep full fidelity for control-plane and customer-facing endpoints. Recommend 10% sampling for infra-only certs.
raj: Agree. For KMS cost concerns, we can enable local enroll caching (5m) for non-sensitive paths to reduce decrypt calls. Will add a config flag per service.
jon: Example envoy config for jittered refresh backoff:
```
retry_policy:
  initial_backoff: 2s
  max_backoff: 30s
  jitter: 0.2
```
Use that on sidecar cert fetch.
kelsey: RBAC change plan (high level):
- create transient session layer in auth-proxy
- allow cert swap to map old session -> new cert for 10m grace
- feature flag behind `short_ttl` per cluster
Need owners: @maria for policy, @raj for rollout, @jon for SRE.
maria: Also need to update audit pipeline: add new indexing field `cert_ttl` and an ingestion-side sampler keyed by `service_tier`. We should not drop audit events entirely — only reducing ingestion retention for sampled events.
raj: KMS integration Q: can we increase decrypt concurrency for APAC master key? Who owns quota? @kelsey — if we request an increase, what's the expected lead time?
kelsey: We can request quota bump from cloud provider; usually 24-72h for approval. Short-term: create a regional fallback key in APAC to split load, and set client-side key selection by hash of service id.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary rollout to apac-cluster-2 at 2026-03-25T02:00Z. Will run in 15% of nodes, staggered over 30m. Notify `#eng-sre` on start.
sam-oncall: I drafted a short incident stub for the runbook — included rollback command and traffic-shift steps. Pasted snippet:
```
# rollback
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/auth-proxy CERT_TTL=24h
kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-proxy -n infra
```
raj: Thanks. Action items I captured:
- raj: add feature-flagged rollout PR + docs
- kelsey: start quota request + add regional key split
- maria: update audit sampler + index mapping
- jon: add KMS error-rate alert and jitter defaults
- sam-oncall: finalize runbook and add to oncall checklist
Any objections to proceed with canary per deploy-bot? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:
maria: :thumbsup:
jon: :thumbsup:
kelsey: :thumbsup:
sam-oncall: :thumbsup:
raj: Going ahead with canary. Will post follow-ups and a short postmortem template in thread if anything odd shows up.
